tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check a domain before your agent trusts a link, a sender or a counterparty: does it exist, where does its mail go, SPF and DMARC policy, nameservers, DNSSEC. Free tier (preview). For registration age, registrar, parking detection and a 0-100 risk score use the paid x402 endpoint /v1/domain.

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Check an email address an agent is about to store, email or trust: syntax, disposable / throwaway provider, role account, free webmail. Free tier (no network). For MX, mail auth, domain age and a verdict (valid | risky | undeliverable) use the paid x402 endpoint /v1/email.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email · Public sink: check_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email · Public sink: check_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
